# ghost_branch_default (Resource)

Sets the default branch of a Ghost repository. `ghost_repository.default_branch` manages the same setting: use one or the other, not both, or they will keep undoing each other's change. Use this resource when the default branch is one Terraform creates with `ghost_branch`, since a new repository has only the branch `auto_init` made. Destroying it sets the default branch back to `previous_branch`, so the branch can then be deleted. Ghost won't delete the default branch, so to move the default off a `ghost_branch` and remove that branch, change `branch` in one apply and remove the old `ghost_branch` in the next: in a single apply, Terraform deletes the branch before it updates this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  auto_init = true

  # Don't set default_branch here as well: ghost_branch_default manages the
  # same setting, and the two would keep undoing each other's change.
}

resource "ghost_branch" "development" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  branch     = "development"
}

# Referencing the ghost_branch creates the branch first. Destroying this
# resource sets the default branch back to main, so the branch can then be
# deleted.
resource "ghost_branch_default" "example" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  branch     = ghost_branch.development.branch
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) The branch to make the default, without the `refs/heads/` prefix. It must already exist; for a branch Terraform creates, use `ghost_branch.example.branch` so it is created first and, on destroy, deleted only after the default has moved off it. Branch names are case-sensitive.
- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`.
- `previous_branch` (String) The default branch before this resource was created. Destroying the resource sets the default branch back to it if it still exists, and otherwise leaves the default branch as it is. Null after import, in which case destroying the resource only removes it from state.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The default branch is imported by the repository's full name, "owner/slug".
# An imported resource has no previous_branch, so destroying it only removes it
# from state.
terraform import ghost_branch_default.example my-user/example
```
